name: Benchmark Movement Data Set for Trust Assessment
description: Trust is a factor that is becoming more prominent in human robot interaction research. Only few approaches so far tackle the challenge of data-driven trust assessment. In this paper, we present a data set consisting of motion tracking data from an industrial human robot collaboration task. The data is collected during a trust manipulation experiment that has been designed to elicit different trust levels in the participants. Additionally, participants filled out a standard trust questionnaire. The data set allows for developing and testing data-driven trust assessment algorithms.CCS CONCEPTS• Human-centered computing → Human computer interaction (HCI); • Computing methodologies → Machine learning.
evaluation_method: accuracy / F1 for classification; correlation or RMSE for regression (task-dependent)
general_score_metric: accuracy (for discrete trust labels) / correlation (for continuous trust scores)
reputation: A niche dataset used in human-robot interaction and trust research with limited but growing adoption for benchmarking trust-estimation models.
notes: Small/lab-controlled dataset typical of HRI studies; human-label variability and demographic sampling can limit generalizability; non-LLM benchmark focused on movement/trajectory data and trust annotations.
